conventions.convention: Coordinates start at 1. The hyperrectangle condition is sup_i i^(1+2β) θ_i² ≤ M, with β>0 and M>0; M bounds squared coordinates rather than their magnitudes.
Polished tails require sum_{i≥N} θ_i² ≤ L₀ sum_{N≤i≤floor(ρN)} θ_i² for every integer N≥N₀, where L₀≥1, N₀≥1 and ρ≥2.
AC is assumed. The observation noise has variance 1/n, and κ_i may have either sign but is nonzero with C^(-2)i^(-2p) ≤ κ_i² ≤ C²i^(-2p).

Maximization uses the same increasing-coordinate likelihood series on [0,A_n]. A common Borel full-probability domain, finite convergence, upper semicontinuity and a supplied Borel maximizing selector are explicit procedure hypotheses. At selected α=0 the credible set is all of ℓ² and r(0)=∞; no ℓ² posterior is asserted there.
The lower bracket uses threshold (16C⁸)^(-1) and inf ∅=A; the upper bracket uses threshold 8C⁸ and sup ∅=0.
Uniform conservative coverage assumes θ₀,₁=0 and tends to one after sufficient inflation. The growing-cap regime requires A_n ≤ sqrt(log n)/(4 sqrt(log(ρ∨e))) and L_n ≥ K_infl (3ρ^(3(1+2p)))^(A_n).
The sparse-gap construction uses fixed A>β, 0<M≤(1984C⁸)^(-1), ρ_j=2^j, n₁=2 and n_{j+1}=ceil((2ρ_{j+1}²)^(1+2β+2p)n_j). Its inflation bound is eventual along n_j.

load_bearing.statement: Under the defined procedure and the stated eventual cap on A_n, the likelihood has a continuous score on [0,A_n]; its centered score divided by V_α(1+h_α) tends uniformly to zero in expected supremum over polished-tail truths. The lemma also supplies the two expectation inequalities, the polished-tail comparison h_a ≤ (4+36L₀ρ^(1+2b))(N_b/N_a)h_b, and an arbitrary-ℓ²-truth bound on deterministic intervals where h_α≤H for fixed H.

For the defined procedure, polished-tail truths with θ₀,₁=0 have P(underline α_n≤α̂_n≤overline α_n)→1 uniformly, for fixed A or the stated growing cap. The endpoint rate ratio is at most [128C¹⁶{4+36L₀ρ^(1+2A_n)}]^(1+2p). The lower bracket alone holds uniformly over arbitrary ℓ² truths under the same procedure/domain hypotheses.

Assuming AC and the stated inverse sequence model, for every fixed α>0 the prior is supported on ℓ² and its posterior kernel is the product of normals with mean nκ_i x_i/(i^(1+2α)+nκ_i²) and variance 1/(i^(1+2α)+nκ_i²). This kernel and mean are supported on ℓ² almost surely under each stated truth. The displayed likelihood series is the log prior-predictive density relative to the noise-only product law almost surely under that reference law, and converges absolutely there and under each stated true sampling law.

For 0≤a≤b≤A_n, N_{n,A_n}→∞ and A_n/N_{n,A_n}→0, the posterior radius satisfies r(b)²≥dR_b when b>0. For polished-tail θ with θ₁=0 and h_n(b;θ)≤8C⁸, sup_{a≤α≤b}||B(α)||²≤K(1+L₀ρ^(2q_b))R_b. With probability at least 1−K/N_{n,a}, sup_{a≤α≤b}||W(α)||²≤KR_a, also at a=0.

Under the defined procedure, fixed model and polished-tail parameters, γ∈(0,1), and θ₀,₁=0, a finite sufficiently large inflation gives coverage tending uniformly to one. The stated growing-cap regime has the same conclusion for every deterministic inflation sequence satisfying its displayed lower bound.

For β>0, the stated inverse model, fixed A>β and 0<M≤(1984C⁸)^(-1), the explicit fixed sparse-gap truth has θ₀,₁=0 and belongs to Θ_β(M). Its coverage tends to zero along n_j for every deterministic nonnegative inflation sequence eventually bounded there by K_L sqrt(M) ρ_j^((1+2p)/(8+8β+8p)).

published_dependencies.used_for: Definition of ℓ², its norm and coordinatewise square summability.
Explicit choice assumption inherited throughout the probability model.
Product measurable spaces and generating finite-coordinate cylinders.
Normal-law convention, affine pushforward construction and standard normal density.
AC supplies countable and dependent choice for the product constructions.
Existence and uniqueness of the countable Gaussian product laws.
Normalization and positivity in the local scalar posterior and evidence calculation.
Affine changes of variables establishing the normal densities and Gaussian integrals.
Normal first and second moments in support, score, radius and noise calculations.
Extension of cylinder conditional-law identities and identification of product probability measures.
Interchanging nonnegative coordinate sums, expectations and parameter integrals.
Expected absolute-value bounds from score variances and derivative integration.
Posterior-radius lower bounds and uniform posterior-mean noise bounds.

seams_checked.note: Read the prerequisite page and its Normal–Normal update. The coordinate conjugate formulas agree after rescaling by nonzero κ_i. The assigned posterior lemma derives its scalar and infinite-product results locally and does not import a finite-dimensional theorem as an infinite-dimensional result.

Read the prerequisite page and Type-II definition. The assigned procedure explicitly distinguishes that finite-group dominated hierarchy from its sequence model, supplies its own endpoint/domain/selector hypotheses, and proves its own likelihood and coverage results. No generic coverage guarantee or existence of a measurable maximizer is attributed to the prerequisite.
